seriesTitle: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You

episodes.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: After a lousy day at work, Sasaki is invited by a young woman to have a smoke with her.

episodes.title: Cheering Up Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Between cigarettes, Tayama and Sasaki share the problems they've had at work.

episodes.title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You and More
episodes.summary: Between cigarettes, Tayama gives Sasaki a gift, and Sasaki decides to return the favor.

episodes.title: Learning Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Between cigarettes, Sasaki learns to use a smartphone and gets to know Tayama better.

episodes.title: Hanging Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Poor Sasaki endures 15 grueling days at work and barely gets to see Tayama.

episodes.title: Lingering Scent Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Between cigarette and cigarette, Sasaki has a health check and is concerned about the results.

episodes.title: The End of Summer Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Gotou tells Yamada to take an exam as summer bows out along with its associated shenanigans.

episodes.title: Searching Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: Tayama has lost something dear to her, and it has to be found in secret!

episodes.title: Asking Behind the Supermarket Alone
episodes.summary: The supermarket employees discover a whole new fact about Sasaki. How will Tayama take it?

episodes.title: Shining Behind the Supermarket with You
episodes.summary: As Christmas rolls around, Sasaki runs into an unfamiliar face in the smoking area.
